name: Model queries
responsibility: A model's readings, records, claims, checkpoints and modules as cached queries, the one query of a history analysis, the vault's query keys and its live feed
description: TASK-653.14: 13 names. architectureModelQuery, architectureRecordQuery, architectureSummaryQuery, architectureClaimsQuery, architectureCheckpointsQuery, architectureModuleQuery, retainedModuleQuery, readModel, historyQuery, ArchitectureReadError, vaultQueryKey, invalidateModelQueries(client, vault?), which absorbs invalidateVaultQueries, and architectureFeed. The key table, readReply and createFeedSocket are private; readReply reads each model reply through model-contract's reply reader. historyQuery(vault, request, { key, accept }) takes a request typed from code-intel's history request schema and spells its query string in field order, so no caller builds one. It owns the route, the refusal as ArchitectureReadError, the wrong-analysis sentence, the freshness options and the read without a signal; each caller keeps its key tail and checks or narrows the answer in accept, inside the read. vaultQueryKey puts a behavior's own read under the vault's prefix, so invalidateModelQueries reads it again. Every other query lives with the behavior that reads it: locality, publication, source lines and walkthroughs in parts of Model reading; the footprint, the source refs and the merge base in Branch footprint; exports in Code exports; explanations in Explanation requests; drawing in Reading preparation.

outgoing.label: one history analysis, from locality to the merge base
